title: Excavations in Palestine and Trans-Jordan, 1938-9: Jerusalem. The Citadel
author: (round-up, Department of Antiquities)
location_note: Courtyard of the Citadel, Jerusalem; placed by name.
notes: 1938-9 soundings at the 'Tower of David': fortification line established not later than the 2nd c. BC, breached and rebuilt, Herodian tower basement (Phasael?), Byzantine wall continuation, Umayyad-style residence, Crusader and Mamluk castle. Fortifications not eligible. The conduit is the same legionary system reported in the 1950 summary (QDAP14-121); not deduplicated.

features.site: south-east of the back of the 'Corner' tower (LM)
features.subtype: pottery conduit with foundations, 'demonstrably the work of the Tenth Legion Fretensis'
features.period: Tenth Legion (Roman garrison after AD 70); no closer date in this report
features.quote: Foundations and a pottery con- duit, demonstrably the work of the Tenth
